Marvel Super Hero Squad - The Infinity G.name: Marvel Super Hero Squad: The Infinity Gauntlet
Marvel Super Hero Squad - The Infinity G.summary: Marvel Super Hero Squad: The Infinity Gauntlet is a continuation of the video game Marvel Super Hero Squad and it was released on November 16, 2010. Similar to the first game, it features cartoonish Super-deformed versions of the Marvel Comics characters, as seen in the Marvel Super Hero Squad toy line, as well as the television show.
